checks.result: Full non-system suite: 1560 runs, 4394 assertions, 0 failures, 0 errors, 1 skip. The two new admin sort regression tests fail on unpatched code and pass after the fix.
checks.follow_up: Run via ruby -Itest glob loader, NOT `bin/rails test`: the rake path pulls test:prepare -> css:install and aborts without bun, and a piped exit 0 masks the abort.

checks.result: Integration sessions do NOT persist here: IntegrationTestCase#sign_in sets session[:current_session_id] but the cookie is never written, so the next request is anonymous.
checks.follow_up: So a test asserting 'redirects to root_path' can pass for the wrong reason (authenticate_user! redirects there too). Use ActionController::TestCase with @request.session, and add a happy-path 200 assertion.

checks.result: bin/rubocop 600 files no offenses; bin/rails zeitwerk:check all good; bin/lint-design-system 43 pre-existing DS010 warnings, none blocking, none introduced. safeoutputs update_issue allows only ONE call per run.
checks.follow_up: Spend that single update_issue on the monthly activity issue body, not on closing a duplicate - 2026-10-22 lost the body update that way. bun is NOT on PATH by default: export PATH="$HOME/.local/share/mise/shims:$PATH" before prettier or bun test.

checks.result: The self-hosted runner's mise-shim race (ETXTBSY, exit 126) is runner-side concurrency, not a branch problem. The repo-side retry for check.yml cannot ship as a PR: the App is refused write access to .github/workflows.
checks.follow_up: A verified one-step diff is in issue #2182 for a maintainer to apply. The durable fix is the runner's job-concurrency setting, outside this repo.

checks.result: All 7 open Repo Assist PRs (#2181, #2178, #2176, #2172, #2171, #2169, #2163) have a green Check job; no follow-up commits were needed.
checks.follow_up: #2172 shows no Check run because CHANGELOG.md is outside check.yml's paths filter - that is not a failure.
